spf.comment: Covers Eibar's 1:2 second-half transition victory against Girona's depleted flanks alongside a 1:1 stalemate, as a single call ignores either Eibar's 66.7% away win rate or Girona's 75.0% home unbeaten record.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.74 combined lambda, 2.94 combined xG per match, Eibar's 66.7% away Over 2.5 rate, and starting left-back absences on both sides.

btts.comment: Eibar have scored in 12 of 13 league games (1.49 xG/match) while Girona regain Asprilla and Vanat against a 1.44 xGA defense missing both natural left-backs.

score.comment: Both scorelines reflect mutual flank vulnerability, led by Eibar's late-scoring edge for 1:2 with 1:1 as the high-density stalemate branch.

goals.comment: A 2.74 lambda_total and depleted wide defenses push 3 goals marginally ahead of the 2-goal Poisson peak.

bqc.comment: Girona have never trailed at half-time at home while Eibar score 54.5% of their goals after the break, pointing to a level first half before a second-half decision or 1:1 hold.
